item.title: Total lunar eclipse transforms sky over Marion County
item.description: A total lunar eclipse, or "Blood Moon," transformed the night sky for Marion County residents on Tuesday morning. Read more: Total lunar eclipse transforms sky over Marion County

item.title: Howard E. Smith
item.description: Howard Smith lived a long life grounded in family, hard work and integrity. He married the love of his life, Theresa A. Smith. Together, they built a beautiful life filled with laughter, love, and warmth, raising two children. Read more: Howard E. Smith

item.title: Marion officials seeking public input on potential widening of CR 484 to six lanes near I-75
item.description: The Marion County Board of County Commissioners is inviting residents to a public meeting to provide feedback on proposed improvements along County Road 484, including the possibility of widening the roadway from four to six lanes around its busy intersection with Interstate 75. Read more: Marion officials seeking public input on potential widening of CR 484 to six lanes near I-75

item.title: Frederick Holton
item.description: Frederick Holton will be remembered for his steady presence, strong sense of responsibility, and lifelong commitment to serving others. His legacy lives on in the family he loved, the officers he trained, and the community he helped protect. Read more: Frederick Holton

item.title: Raising Cane’s opens first Ocala restaurant on State Road 200
item.description: Dozens of residents lined up on Tuesday morning for the grand opening of the first Raising Cane’s Chicken Fingers restaurant in Ocala. Read more: Raising Cane’s opens first Ocala restaurant on State Road 200

item.title: William Albert Yates Jr.
item.description: William Yates Jr. loved spending time with friends and family. His lifelong hobby was buy-sell-trade. Bill always had a smile on his face. Read more: William Albert Yates Jr.

item.title: Another Ocala shopping center sold for $7 million
item.description: A shopping center located just off Interstate 75 in Ocala has just been sold for $7 million, following the sales of several other similar local facilities over the past few months. Read more: Another Ocala shopping center sold for $7 million

item.title: Marion grandma accused of firing gun near grandson to ‘scare’ him
item.description: A Marion County grandmother who wanted to “scare” her grandson is now facing aggravated assault charges after she allegedly fired her gun near him on two separate occasions. Read more: Marion grandma accused of firing gun near grandson to ‘scare’ him

item.title: SR 200 is bad, but CR 484 is worse
item.description: "You complain about the recent concerns of SR 200, but roadwork on CR 484 has been going on since we moved here in 2020 and no improvements to the road work is noticed. Getting through the light at the corner of CR 484, when approaching (about a half a mile before the light) where the RaceTrac and Cracker Barrel meet is so much worse and will take you 45 minutes to an hour to get from that light to the one at Marion Oaks Blvd. Ocala’s traffic is putting its residents through Hell and improvement
